subject: Secure SDLC evidence: change approval playbook & secrets access trail
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@proofaudits.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Security Team <security@atlasfinancial.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Secure SDLC evidence — change approval & secrets access trail

Olga,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Atlas Financial's SIG assessment we need targeted evidence related to change management and secrets handling for services that process customer PII. Specifically could you provide:

- The current change approval "playbook" or runbook showing approval steps, roles, and emergency exception handling (last 12 months).
- PR gating logs / code review evidence for production-affecting repos (sample of 5 PRs covering the past 6 months).
- CI/CD policy summary and an example pipeline config showing enforcement of gated merges.
- Secrets lifecycle records (rotation events, owner IDs, who requested access) for the vault(s) that contain service credentials — redacted where necessary.
- Audit trail showing approvals for any emergency/rollback changes in the last 12 months.

If any items are large, a Drive folder link is fine. Target timeline: ideally by EOD next Friday (2028-06-09) to keep the assessment schedule. Let me know if we need to scope or redact.

Best,
Sonia
Sonia Patel
Senior Assessor, ProofAudits
sonia.patel@proofaudits.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: request_checklist.txt (1KB)
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@proofaudits.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Secure SDLC evidence — change approval & secrets access trail

Hi Sonia,

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it — target delivery EOD 2028-06-09. We will provide a Drive folder with the artifacts and a short index (see attached) so you can locate the items quickly.

Quick notes / scope:
- Runbook: we will provide the current change_approval_runbook and highlight the emergency exception workflow.
- PR gating: we'll supply an extract of PR metadata (author, reviewers, approvals, CI status) for five representative production PRs.
- CI/CD: summary + a redacted pipeline snippet showing gated merge checks and required jobs.
- Secrets: we will provide rotation events & owner IDs; any secrets themselves will be redacted.
- Emergency changes: we'll include the ticket references and approval emails for any emergency rollbacks in the last 12 months.

If you need raw logs instead of the CSV extracts, tell us and we can arrange a secure upload.

Uploading: sdlc_evidence_index.csv to shared Drive now; full bundle will follow.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: sdlc_evidence_index.csv (stub)
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 05 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Request: Secure SDLC evidence — change approval & secrets access trail

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Sonia's request. Can you each own the items below and reply with attachments / links by Thu 06/08 EOD so I can package them for the assessor?

Marissa: change approval runbook, PR gating extracts (5 PRs), emergency exception approvals. Please include PR IDs and links to internal ticket IDs (redact customer PII).
Rishi: secrets rotation audit (last 12 months) for vault:redwood-services; list of vault admins and temporary access grants; CI/CD policy summary and redacted pipeline snippet showing gating enforcement.

Make sure all artifacts have a one-line description in the filename. If any sensitive fields need redaction, put a brief redaction note in the file header.

Thanks — Olga

--
Internal: please do not forward outside the compliance channel without approval.
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Jun 2028 14:18:00 -07:00

Olga / Rishi,

Attached are the items I pulled together:

- change_approval_runbook_v2.pdf — current playbook with approval matrix and emergency exception steps (sensitive emails redacted).
- pr_gate_log_2028_Q1-Q2.csv — extract with columns: pr_id, repo, author, reviewers, approvals, ci_status, merge_time, ticket_id (ticket_id redacted).
- emergency_change_emails.pdf — compiled approval emails and rollback notes for two emergency incidents in 2027/2028.

Notes: PR extracts include PR metadata only; full diffs are available on request but we redacted any customer data. I put these in the Drive folder and set viewer access for ProofAudits.

Marissa Cole

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jun 2028 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: Secure SDLC evidence — change approval & secrets access trail

Olga/Marissa — uploaded the secrets and CI artifacts to the shared Drive folder. Summary below and samples attached.

- vault_rotation_audit_2028.csv — rotation events, rotating_key_id, rotated_by (internal id), timestamp, rotation_type (scheduled/forced). Sensitive values redacted.
- ci_pipeline_policy_summary.txt — human-readable summary of pipeline enforcement: required status checks, branch protection, required approvals, and automated policy engine that blocks merges if secret-scan fails.
- pipeline_snippet_redacted.txt — redacted YAML snippet showing gated jobs (lint -> unit-tests -> integration -> deploy) and the condition that requires two approvers for prod merge.

Sample (redacted) event from vault_rotation_audit_2028.csv: 
rotating_key_id: rk-1a2b3c, rotated_by: rishi.m, timestamp: 2028-02-10T03:12:00Z, rotation_type: scheduled

If the assessor needs raw audit logs (to run their own queries), we can provide a time-limited export via our SSO-secured transfer.

Rishi Malhotra
Infrastructure Security Engineer
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Request: Secure SDLC evidence — change approval & secrets access trail

Olga / team,

Received — thank you. I reviewed the runbook, PR extracts, rotation audit, and pipeline snippets. This addresses our primary concerns on change governance and secret rotation. One quick clarification: for emergency exception approvals, can you confirm whether exceptions created outside the runbook flow are later backfilled in the ticketing system (we saw the emails but want to match to ticket IDs)? If so, please send the ticket IDs or point me to the HubSpot link.

If you can drop that last item into the Drive folder, we can mark this scope as closed by EOD today.

Regards,
Sonia
